verdict.rationale: Marqeta's docs pages are served as raw markdown at .md URLs (e.g. core-api/cards.md, introduction.md, developer-guides/core-api-quick-start.md), which an agent can ingest directly. However, probes show no llms.txt index (404) and no root docs.md (404), so there is no documented agent entry point; the MCP server is a separate story and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: an llms.txt or llms-full.txt index, a root markdown docs entry point, explicit first-party documentation of agent-oriented docs access, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents can consume the .md pages.
